lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 high-contrast vertical lines identified. Spacing is widest in the mid-torso region (approximately 40-50 pixels relative to torso length) and decreases in interval as lines approach the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is observed at the ventral terminus of the 7th line from the shoulder, where the line splits into two distinct segments before reaching the belly line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 10, 11, and 12 are fragmented into series of vertically aligned dashes and do not form continuous paths from the dorsal ridge to the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A dense grouping of 6 distinct white spots is located on the upper haunch, clustered in a roughly circular formation superior to the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of 3 spots on the mid-thigh creates a semi-connected geometric line spanning approximately 15% of the posterior width.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots are visible on the cheek region; a prominent white transverse band is visible at the junction of the lower neck and chest.
